# BlockFlow

> Browser extension (Chrome/Brave/Edge, Firefox) for building browser automations from connected
> blocks, n8n style: form filling, end-to-end tests, monitoring, scraping. Workflows are JSON
> (nodes + edges) that users import into the extension.

To generate or explain workflows, read in this order:

- [Usage guide](docs/guide/README.md): concepts, workflow file format, templates, locators, waiting, branching, step settings, rules for AI tools
- [Block reference](docs/guide/blocks.md): every block type, its config keys, defaults and outputs (generated from the code)
- [Block reference, JSON](docs/guide/blocks.json)
- [Workflow JSON Schema](docs/guide/workflow.schema.json)
- [Example workflows](docs/guide/examples/): importable, checked by tests

To change BlockFlow's code:

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): commands and codebase rules
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Internals wiki](docs/wiki/Home.md): file-by-file reference of the code
- [Plan and status](docs/PLAN-automation.md)
